title: Recursive Game Creator: An Agentic Product-Level Experience-Oriented Game Harness

paragraphs.en: Recent game design agents have made substantial progress in generating playable games. However, program correctness does not ensure an enjoyable experience for players. We present Recursive Game Creator, an experience-oriented harness to advance agentic game development from rough game prototypes into entertaining games. Recursive Game Creator organizes recursive development around four components: Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The Designer translates user instructions and Reviewer’s feedback into detailed plans. The Builder turns these plans into candidate games. The coding-native Player creates and executes reusable policies through programmatic interfaces to efficiently collect diverse gameplay trajectories, mitigating evaluation bias caused by slow GUI-based collection. The Reviewer uses carefully designed trajectory-based metrics to induce player preferences, integrating with visual evidence and explicit textual preferences to evaluate games against game-specific criteria. Finally, the Reviewer accepts the better version and provides improvement reviews for the next round, closing the recursive loop. Our method achieves state-of-the-art overall performance of 77.89 on GameCraft-Bench. On GameASG-Bench, it achieves a strict task success rate of 53.2%, a 34.1% improvement over the same-model baseline, and the highest mean runtime-check pass rate at 93.4% among compared methods. A user study shows longer playtime and higher ratings. Code is coming soon.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的游戏设计智能体在生成可玩性高的游戏方面取得了显著进展。 然而，程序的正确性并不保证能为玩家带来愉悦的体验。 我们提出了“递归式游戏创作者”（Recursive Game Creator），这是一种以体验为导向的框架，旨在将智能体驱动的游戏开发从粗糙的原型推进到真正有趣的游戏。 “递归式游戏创作者”围绕四个组件组织递归式开发流程：设计师、构建者、玩家和评审者。 设计师会将用户指令和评审者的反馈转化为详细的计划。 构建者则将这些计划转化为候选游戏。 具备编码能力的玩家通过程序接口创建并执行可重用的策略，从而高效地收集多样化的游戏过程轨迹，缓解因基于图形用户界面的缓慢收集方式所导致的评估偏差。 评审者利用精心设计的基于游戏过程轨迹的指标来推断玩家偏好，并结合视觉证据与明确的文本偏好，依据特定游戏的标准对游戏进行评估。 最后，评审者会接受更优的版本，并为下一轮提供改进建议，从而完成递归循环。 我们的方法在 GameCraft-Bench 测试集上实现了 77.89 的当前最佳整体性能。 在 GameASG-Bench 测试集上，该方法实现了 53.2% 的严格任务成功率，比同模型基线提升了 34.1%，并且在所比较的方法中获得了最高的平均运行时检查通过率（93.4%）。 用户研究表明，游戏时长更长且评分更高。代码即将发布。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents can rapidly build runnable games, but successful execution does not establish the quality of play. Engaging mechanics, appropriate difficulty, coherent presentation, and responsive feedback shape player experience. Recent agentic workflows support iterative game development ( Yan et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) , yet translating gameplay into experience-oriented revision remains challenging. Progress toward product-level games requires a harness that connects development with repeated playtesting and adapts the game to its intended players.

paragraphs.en: We introduce Recursive Game Creator , an experience-oriented recursive harness to iteratively refine games. The harness mirrors a real game studio of four typical roles: Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer, as shown in Fig. 2 . Starting from a user instruction, the Designer expands into a comprehensive design graph that includes gameplay mechanisms, storylines, feedback systems, and visual asset requirements. The Builder calls proper external tools, implementing the game backend, organizing audiovisual assets, and managing the project. Unlike previous work Huang et al. (2026) ; Hu et al. (2026) with a GUI agent to test the game, we propose a Coding-Native Player that writes executable policies to collect gameplay trajectories efficiently and effectively. The Experience-Oriented Reviewer leverages diverse gameplay trajectories to conduct a thorough, game-specific diagnosis, including difficulty assessment, corner-bug discovery, and time-in-game recording. The Reviewer also leverages screenshots to evaluate game appearance. Finally, the Reviewer provides feedback to the Designer for next-round refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出递归游戏创建器（Recursive Game Creator），这是一种以体验为导向的递归框架，用于迭代优化游戏。 该框架模拟了一个拥有四个典型角色的真实游戏工作室：设计师、构建者、玩家和评审员，如图 2 所示。 从用户指令开始，设计师会扩展出一个全面的设计图，其中包含游戏玩法机制、故事情节、反馈系统以及视觉资产需求。 构建者调用适当的外部工具，实现游戏后端、组织视听资产并管理项目。 与 Huang 等人（2026）；Hu 等人 （2026）使用 GUI 智能体测试游戏的先前的工作不同，我们提出了一种编码原生玩家，它能编写可执行策略，从而高效且有效地收集游戏玩法轨迹。 以体验为导向的评审员利用多样化的游戏玩法轨迹，进行全面的、针对特定游戏的诊断，包括难度评估、边缘情况漏洞发现以及游戏内时间记录。 评审员还利用截图来评估游戏的外观。 最后，评审员向设计师提供反馈，以便进行下一轮的优化。

paragraphs.en: Although coding agents can interact with games through graphical user interfaces (GUIs) ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , screenshot-driven testing may omit structured state, legal actions, events, and progress signals available through programmatic interfaces. Requiring visual interpretation and a model decision for each action adds latency and limits frequent, fine-grained rollouts. Coding agents are primarily optimized for code generation and reasoning, rather than fine-grained visual game-state interpretation. To better align gameplay with these strengths, our Coding-Native Player provides frequent, repeatable, and diverse interaction through programmatic interfaces. Player constructs reusable policies with different strategies and capabilities. We execute policies to collect trajectories. This separates fast gameplay control from policy construction and the Reviewer’s visual assessment. It also preserves directly exposed state and event information for subsequent analysis. The Coding-Native Player offers several distinct advantages, including: high-frequency control, efficient trajectory collection, diverse capability simulation, and reproducible results.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管编码智能体可以通过图形用户界面（GUI）与游戏进行交互（Huang 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026a），但基于截图的测试可能会忽略通过程序化接口可用的结构化状态、合法操作、事件和进度信号。 每次操作都需要进行视觉解读和模型决策，这会引入延迟并限制频繁、精细的执行。 编码智能体主要针对代码生成和推理进行优化，而非对游戏状态的精细视觉解读。 为了更好地将游戏玩法与这些优势对齐，我们的“编码原生玩家”通过程序化接口提供频繁、可重复且多样化的交互。 玩家可以构建具有不同策略和能力的可复用策略。 我们执行这些策略以收集轨迹数据。 这将快速的游戏玩法控制与策略构建以及评审员的视觉评估分离开来。 同时，这也保留了直接暴露的状态和事件信息，以便后续分析。 “编码原生玩家”具有若干显著优势，包括：高频控制、高效的轨迹收集、多样化的能力模拟以及可复现的结果。

paragraphs.en: The Reviewer provides comprehensive feedback from collected trajectories. The Experience-Oriented Reviewer combines general standards such as playtime, success rate, and game-specific rubric evaluations to identify problems. Different types of games matter in different aspects. Beyond general evaluation, the Reviewer further analyzes suitable specific features of each game. For example, Responsive steering matters in racing, whereas a meaningful storyline and coherent dialogue matter in a visual novel. The Reviewer actively figures out these specific analysis criteria. The Reviewer expresses inferred preferences as structured text describing the desired experience, supporting observations, and revision priorities. Users can also supply explicit textual preferences during play. These inputs guide the next design plan, allowing refinement to address both game quality and a player’s taste.

The Designer translates feedback into a plan. The Builder implements a new candidate for further testing. We evaluate the games on GameCraft-Bench ( Luo et al., 2026 ) and GameASG-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . paragraphs.en: Code generation allows agents to work beyond software development, including video creation and embodied tasks. For educational videos, Code2Video combines planning, Python code generation, and visual review to improve the rendered layout ( Chen et al., 2025b ) . VideoAgent uses generated code to create animations and combines them with slides and narration for scientific videos ( Liang et al., 2026 ) . VideoCoCo uses a coding agent to write Blender programs that produce dynamic scene drafts. A video generation model then turns these drafts into realistic videos ( Li et al., 2026 ) . In embodied control, Code as Policies turns language instructions into robot policy code that connects perception with control APIs ( Liang et al., 2023 ) . ProgPrompt uses program-like descriptions of available actions and objects to generate robot task plans ( Singh et al., 2022 ) . Voyager builds a library of reusable Minecraft skills and revises their code using environment feedback and execution errors ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . Eureka extends code generation to reward design, using feedback from policy training to revise reward functions ( Ma et al., 2024 ) . Across these applications, code gives agents a way to express, execute, and reuse structured behavior. These works motivate our use of executable policies for gameplay testing. Our focus is on connecting executable play, experience and preference analysis, and continued game evolution within a recursive harness aimed at product-level games.
paragraphs.zh: 代码生成使智能体能够超越软件开发领域，应用于视频创作和具身任务。 在教育视频中，Code2Video 结合了规划、Python 代码生成和视觉审查，以优化渲染布局（Chen 等人，2025b）。 VideoAgent 利用生成的代码创建动画，并将其与幻灯片和旁白结合，制作科学视频（Liang 等人，2026）。 VideoCoCo 使用编码智能体编写 Blender 程序，以生成动态场景的初稿。 随后，一个视频生成模型将这些初稿转化为逼真的视频（Li 等人，2026）。 在具身控制中，“代码即策略”将语言指令转换为机器人策略代码，连接感知与控制 API（Liang 等人，2023）。 ProgPrompt 利用对可用动作和对象的程序化描述，生成机器人任务计划（Singh 等人，2022）。 Voyager 构建了一个可重复使用的 Minecraft 技能库，并通过环境反馈和执行错误来修订其代码（Wang 等人，2023）。 Eureka 将代码生成扩展到奖励设计，利用策略训练中的反馈来修订奖励函数（Ma 等人，2024）。 在这些应用中，代码为智能体提供了一种表达、执行和复用结构化行为的方式。 这些研究促使我们在游戏测试中使用可执行策略。 我们的重点是连接可执行的玩法、经验与偏好分析，并在一个递归框架内实现游戏的持续演化，目标是开发产品级游戏。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents generate and edit game programs within an explicit runtime. General software-agent systems such as MetaGPT and ChatDev organize planning, implementation, and testing ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) . GameGPT applies role-based collaboration to game development ( Chen et al., 2025a ) . AutoUE targets Unreal Engine workflows, while OpenGame combines reusable project templates with debugging knowledge ( Yin et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Beyond initial generation, AVR-Agent iterates JavaScript content using audio-visual recordings and multimodal comparisons, and Harness-of-Harness supports persistent development with independent assessment ( Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2025 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent work RSIGame explores recursive self-improvement for agentic game development, using iterative evaluation feedback to refine generated games ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . GameDevBench and GameCraft-Bench evaluate engine-grounded development and interactive artifacts. GameXpert-Bench extends evaluation across generation, repair, and cumulative optimization ( Chi et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . However, generating runnable artifacts and repairing functional bugs do not by themselves establish an engaging player experience. We go further by connecting policy generation, trajectory collection, experience and preference analysis, and multi-round game revision, making the quality of play and continued customization explicit refinement targets.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体在明确的运行时环境中生成和编辑游戏程序。 MetaGPT 和 ChatDev 等通用软件智能体系统能够组织规划、实现与测试（Hong 等人，2024；Qian 等人，2024）。 GameGPT 将基于角色的协作应用于游戏开发（Chen 等人，2025a）。 AutoUE 专注于 Unreal Engine 的工作流程，而 OpenGame 则将可重用的项目模板与调试知识相结合（Yin 等人，2026；Jiang 等人，2026）。 除了初始生成阶段，AVR-Agent 还能通过音视频记录和多模态比较迭代优化 JavaScript 内容，而 Harness-of-Harness 则通过独立评估支持持续开发（Jolicoeur-Martineau，2025；Yan 等人，2026）。 同期研究 RSIGame 探索了智能体驱动游戏开发的递归自我改进方法，利用迭代评估反馈来优化生成的游戏（Wu 等人，2026）。 GameDevBench 和 GameCraft-Bench 用于评估基于游戏引擎的开发过程及交互式成果。 GameXpert-Bench 将评估范围扩展至生成、修复与累积优化（Chi 等人，2026；Luo 等人，2026；Chen 等人，2026）。 然而，仅生成可运行的程序或修复功能性缺陷本身，并不足以构建引人入胜的玩家体验。 我们更进一步，将策略生成、轨迹收集、经验与偏好分析以及多轮游戏修订相互关联，使游戏体验质量与持续定制成为明确的优化目标。

paragraphs.en: Self-Refine and Reflexion use feedback to revise outputs or subsequent attempts ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . AFlow, EvoMAC, and the Darwin Gödel Machine instead optimize workflows, collaboration, or agent code ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . A related line makes the optimization objective sensitive to human preferences. Trajectory comparisons can train reward models, while RLHF and direct preference optimization align language-model behavior with preferred outputs ( Christiano et al., 2017 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) . VideoDPO extends preference optimization to video diffusion using automatically scored pairs, which should be distinguished from direct human judgments ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . In games, experience-driven procedural content generation connects player modeling to content adaptation, and experience-driven RL generates racetracks toward target affective patterns ( Yannakakis and Togelius, 2011 ; Barthet et al., 2024 ) . These works motivate feedback tied to the intended experience, while differing in what is optimized and who supplies the feedback. Our harness uses structured preference feedback to revise the game artifact while keeping the underlying model parameters fixed. Explicit user requests and preferences inferred from play inform subsequent design and implementation rounds.
paragraphs.zh: Self-Refine 和 Reflexion 利用反馈来修改输出或后续尝试（Madaan 等，2023；Shinn 等，2023）。 AFlow、EvoMAC 和 Darwin Gödel Machine 则分别优化工作流程、协作或智能体代码（Zhang 等，2025；Hu 等，2025；Zhang 等，2026b）。 相关研究使优化目标对人类的偏好更加敏感。 轨迹比较可以训练奖励模型，而 RLHF 和直接偏好优化则能使语言模型的行为与偏好输出保持一致（Christiano 等，2017；Ouyang 等，2022；Rafailov 等，2023）。 VideoDPO 将偏好优化扩展到视频扩散领域，使用自动评分的成对样本，这与直接的人类判断应有所区分（Liu 等，2025）。 在游戏领域，经验驱动的程序化内容生成将玩家建模与内容适应联系起来，而经验驱动的强化学习则能生成符合目标情感模式的赛道（Yannakakis 和 Togelius，2011；Barthet 等，2024）。 这些研究强调了与预期体验相关的反馈的重要性，但它们在优化对象和反馈来源方面存在差异。 我们的利用方法使用结构化的偏好反馈来修改游戏产物，同时保持底层模型参数固定不变。 明确的用户请求以及从游戏中推断出的偏好，会指导后续的设计和实施阶段。

paragraphs.en: Recursive Game Creator organizes game development as a closed loop involving the Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The Designer translates user requirements and evaluation feedback into a structured plan specifying intended experience, concrete changes, acceptance goals, and asset needs. The Builder implements this plan through draft and integrate stages, incorporates required assets, and performs targeted checks to produce a playable candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 递归游戏创建器将游戏开发组织为一个闭环，涉及设计者、构建者、玩家和评审者。 设计者将用户需求和评估反馈转化为结构化计划，明确预期体验、具体变更、验收目标和资源需求。 构建者通过草案和整合阶段实施该计划，融入所需资源，并进行针对性检查，以生成可玩的候选版本。

paragraphs.en: The Player writes and executes code policies through the game’s programmatic interface, collecting behavioral trajectories and available visual records. These trajectories capture states, actions, events, progress, elapsed time, and termination outcomes, providing inspectable evidence of play. The Reviewer combines Player reports with behavioral and visual evidence to assess the experience against shared and game-specific criteria, and compares anonymized evidence from the candidate and retained versions. These evidence-based judgments inform version retention, while the Reviewer’s findings guide the Designer’s next plan. This loop connects game construction, policy-based play, experience assessment, and iterative refinement.

Lightweight execution and parallel sampling make repeated trials practical, while policies with different strategies can expose failures that one strategy misses. The resulting records connect gameplay behavior to the Reviewer’s diagnosis and the next design revision. Total testing cost includes policy generation, repair, execution, and review. Proxy strategies provide varied test behavior, but do not establish that they represent the full human player population. Human trajectories and explicit feedback supply additional evidence about individual preferences.

paragraphs.en: Shared signals, success rate and playtime. The coding-native Player supplies many trajectories from policies with different skills and strategies. The Reviewer uses this evidence to estimate success rates and examine where play ends or gets stuck. Success that comes too easily may offer little challenge, while repeated failure may cause frustration. The goal is therefore a suitable level of difficulty for the intended players, not the highest possible success rate. Comparing outcomes across policies helps assess whether progress is achievable and whether stronger play is rewarded. For version comparisons, policy settings and observation access must remain consistent.
paragraphs.zh: 共享信号、成功率和游戏时间。 以编码为原生基础的 Player 会提供来自具有不同技能和策略的策略的多种轨迹。 Reviewer 利用这些证据来估计成功率，并检查游戏在何处结束或陷入僵局。 过于轻易的成功可能缺乏挑战，而反复失败则可能导致挫败感。 因此，目标是为预期玩家设定合适的难度水平，而非追求最高的可能成功率。 比较不同策略下的结果有助于评估进展是否可行，以及更强大的游戏表现是否受到奖励。 在进行版本比较时，策略设置和观察访问必须保持一致。

sents.zh: 过于轻易的成功可能缺乏挑战，而反复失败则可能导致挫败感。

sents.en: The goal is therefore a suitable level of difficulty for the intended players, not the highest possible success rate.
sents.zh: 因此，目标是为预期玩家设定合适的难度水平，而非追求最高的可能成功率。

sents.en: Comparing outcomes across policies helps assess whether progress is achievable and whether stronger play is rewarded.
sents.zh: 比较不同策略下的结果有助于评估进展是否可行，以及更强大的游戏表现是否受到奖励。

sents.en: For version comparisons, policy settings and observation access must remain consistent.
sents.zh: 在进行版本比较时，策略设置和观察访问必须保持一致。

paragraphs.en: The same trajectories record playtime. The Reviewer examines run times together with progress, explored content, and reasons for stopping. This helps distinguish a long run with varied activity from one spent stuck at the same point. Success rate and playtime therefore support a broader assessment of difficulty and playability. Both remain measures of the tested policies. Proxy playtime alone does not show human interest or enjoyment.
paragraphs.zh: 相同的轨迹会记录游戏时长。 评审员会结合运行时间、进度、探索内容以及停止原因进行考察。 这有助于区分一个活动多样的长时间运行过程与一个始终困在相同节点的运行过程。 因此，成功率和游戏时长共同支持对难度和可玩性的更广泛评估。 这两项指标仍然是受测策略的衡量标准。 仅凭代理游戏时长无法体现人类的兴趣或享受程度。

paragraphs.en: Game-specific rubric. The Reviewer starts from shared assessment dimensions, including control responsiveness, content richness, narrative or progression pacing, visual coherence, and support for exploration or replay. It instantiates these dimensions as criteria suited to the game’s genre and intended experience. For example, a racing game may require clear track guidance, responsive steering, and visible collision feedback, while a visual novel may require coherent dialogue and choices with discernible consequences. The Reviewer checks consistency between rules, visual cues, and observed play, and explains strengths, weaknesses, and tradeoffs rather than averaging unrelated criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 游戏专用评分标准。 评审员从共享的评估维度出发，包括控制响应性、内容丰富度、叙事或进度节奏、视觉连贯性，以及对探索或重玩的支持。 它将这些维度具体化为符合游戏类型和预期体验的标准。 例如，赛车游戏可能需要清晰的赛道指引、灵敏的转向操作和可见的碰撞反馈，而视觉小说则可能需要逻辑连贯的对话与选择，且这些选择需有明确可辨的后果。 评审员会检查规则、视觉提示与实际观察到的玩法之间的一致性，并解释各项标准的优势、弱点和权衡之处，而非简单对无关标准取平均值。

paragraphs.en: Visual evidence and diagnosis. The Reviewer obtains sampled screenshots and available recordings from rendered gameplay, and examines them alongside play reports without seeing source code or version order. Trajectories show where a policy succeeds, fails, or stops progressing. Rendered views show what a player could see at those moments. The Reviewer uses them to assess text readability, visual style, and action feedback. Visual review is separate from the fast control loop, so collecting a trajectory does not require interpreting an image at every step. Brief effects or missing feedback may still require a recording rather than a few frames.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉证据与诊断。 审核员从渲染的游戏画面中获取采样截图和可用录像，并在不查看源代码或版本顺序的情况下，结合游戏报告进行审查。 轨迹展示了策略成功、失败或停止进展的位置。 渲染画面显示了玩家在这些时刻可能看到的内容。 审核员利用这些材料来评估文本的可读性、视觉风格和操作反馈。 视觉审查与快速控制循环是分离的，因此收集轨迹无需在每一步都解析图像。 短暂的效果或缺失的反馈可能仍然需要完整的录像，而非仅几帧画面。

A failed turn could reflect poor controls, an unclear cue, or a weak policy. When the cause is uncertain, the feedback specifies what further evidence would help resolve it.
paragraphs.zh: 每个观察结果都与对应的游戏版本、策略和重播相关联。 评审员将已发生的事件与其可能发生的原因区分开来。 失败的回合可能反映出操作不当、提示不清或策略薄弱。 当原因不确定时，反馈会说明需要哪些进一步证据才能解决该问题。

paragraphs.en: Structured experience and preference feedback. The Reviewer translates trajectory patterns, visual findings, and explicit user input into a textual preference record. The record describes the desired experience, supporting evidence, whether a preference is inferred or user-stated, and the corresponding revision priority. A tendency to explore optional areas, for example, may suggest interest in discovery. A user’s request for less demanding combat supplies an explicit difficulty target. These observations inform design hypotheses rather than establishing preferences from playtime alone. The Designer receives this record alongside concrete changes and follow-up checks for the next revision.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化的体验与偏好反馈。 评审员将轨迹模式、视觉发现及用户的明确输入转化为文本形式的偏好记录。 该记录描述了期望的体验、支持性证据、偏好是推断得出还是用户直接陈述，以及相应的修订优先级。 例如，倾向于探索可选区域可能表明用户对探索充满兴趣。 用户要求降低战斗难度，则提供了明确的难度目标。 这些观察结果用于形成设计假设，而非仅凭游戏时间就确定偏好。 设计师会收到这份记录，同时还有具体的修改内容以及下一轮修订的后续检查项。

paragraphs.en: Version comparison and retention. The Reviewer compares a candidate with the retained game using the same shared signals and game-specific criteria. It checks whether the changes address the earlier revision goals and introduce new problems. The output is an A/B preference, a tie, or an unavailable judgment, with reasons and evidence paths. Feedback states the problem, its possible cause, its effect on play, and a revision goal with a follow-up check. The harness maps the Reviewer’s judgment back to the game versions and selects which artifact to retain.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Recursive Game Creator on GameCraft-Bench and GameASG-Bench. These benchmarks test game quality and whether generated games meet their requirements. We then examine rollout coverage, representative development examples, and expert assessments of experience-oriented refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 GameCraft-Bench 和 GameASG-Bench 上对 Recursive Game Creator 进行了评估。 这些基准测试用于检验游戏质量，以及生成的游戏是否满足其要求。 接着，我们考察了展开覆盖范围、具有代表性的开发示例，以及专家对体验导向优化的评估。

sents.en: We evaluate Recursive Game Creator on GameCraft-Bench and GameASG-Bench.
sents.zh: 我们在 GameCraft-Bench 和 GameASG-Bench 上对 Recursive Game Creator 进行了评估。

sents.en: These benchmarks test game quality and whether generated games meet their requirements.
sents.zh: 这些基准测试用于检验游戏质量，以及生成的游戏是否满足其要求。

sents.en: We then examine rollout coverage, representative development examples, and expert assessments of experience-oriented refinement.
sents.zh: 接着，我们考察了展开覆盖范围、具有代表性的开发示例，以及专家对体验导向优化的评估。

paragraphs.en: GameCraft-Bench evaluates complete Godot games through replayed gameplay and game-specific rubrics covering mechanics, content depth, functional visuals, and art ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . We run three refinement rounds on 45 selected tasks ( Yan et al., 2026 ) from GameCraft-Bench and report category and overall scores after each round in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: GameCraft-Bench 通过重播游戏过程以及涵盖机制、内容深度、功能性视觉效果和美术的游戏特定评分标准，对完整的 Godot 游戏进行评估（Luo 等人，2026）。 我们对 GameCraft-Bench 中挑选出的 45 项任务（Yan 等人，2026）进行了三轮优化，并在表 1 中报告了每轮优化后的分类得分和总体得分。

sents.en: We run three refinement rounds on 45 selected tasks ( Yan et al., 2026 ) from GameCraft-Bench and report category and overall scores after each round in Table 1 .
sents.zh: 我们对 GameCraft-Bench 中挑选出的 45 项任务（Yan 等人，2026）进行了三轮优化，并在表 1 中报告了每轮优化后的分类得分和总体得分。

paragraphs.en: The GPT-6 Astra baseline scores 71.26 overall. Recursive Game Creator improves overall quality from 72.70 in the first round to 77.89 in the third, a gain of 5.19 points across rounds and 6.63 points over the same-model baseline. The final score exceeds the strongest reported baseline by 6.37 points, and all five categories improve across our three rounds. Action shows the largest increase, from 67.96 to 77.62 (+9.66). Its first two rounds remain below the same-model baseline Action score of 73.33, before reaching 77.62 in the third. One possible explanation is that action-game quality depends on coordinated changes to controls, collision handling, combat feedback, and progression, whose interactions can require several playtest and revision cycles. The larger late-stage gain is consistent with this interpretation, although the category scores alone do not identify its cause.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-6 Astra 基线模型的整体得分为 71.26。 Recursive Game Creator 的整体质量从第一轮 72.70 提升至第三轮 77.89，各轮次间提升了 5.19 分，相较于同一模型的基线模型则提升了 6.63 分。 最终得分比已报道的最强基线模型高出 6.37 分，且在我们三轮测试中，五个类别的得分均有所提升。 Action 类别的提升最大，从 67.96 增至 77.62（+9.66）。 其前两轮得分仍低于同一模型基线模型中 Action 类别的 73.33 分，直到第三轮才达到 77.62。 一种可能的解释是，动作游戏的质量取决于控制机制、碰撞处理、战斗反馈和进度推进等要素的协同调整，而这些要素之间的相互作用可能需要多次测试与迭代。 后期阶段更显著的提升与这一解释相符，但仅凭各类别得分尚无法确定具体原因。

paragraphs.en: GameASG-Bench tests whether generated browser games meet their source and behavior requirements ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . L1 checks the source code, while L2 runs the game in a browser. P0 covers startup and the test interface, P1 covers required gameplay, and P2 covers extended features. Task success requires valid delivery, completed evaluation, and passing every L1 check and every applicable L2 P0/P1 check. We report this measure alongside check pass rates in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: GameASG-Bench 测试生成的浏览器游戏是否符合其源代码和行为要求（Zhang 等人，2026c）。 L1 检查源代码，而 L2 则在浏览器中运行游戏。 P0 涵盖启动和测试界面，P1 涵盖必需的游戏玩法，P2 涵盖扩展功能。 任务成功需要有效交付、完成评估，并通过所有 L1 检查以及所有适用的 L2 P0/P1 检查。 我们在表 2 中与该指标一同报告了各项检查的通过率。

paragraphs.en: Recursive Game Creator is an experience-oriented recursive harness that connects design, tool-assisted implementation, executable play, and preference-informed review. Its coding-native Player collects reusable gameplay trajectories through programmatic interfaces, while the Reviewer combines behavioral evidence, visual observations, and user input to guide version selection and subsequent revisions. This policy-to-trajectory-to-feedback loop enables continued game evolution with fixed model parameters. Across our evaluations, Recursive Game Creator achieves state-of-the-art overall performance on GameCraft-Bench and the highest mean runtime-check pass rate among compared methods on GameASG-Bench. Development examples and expert assessments characterize improvements in controls, content, and presentation. The harness provides a foundation for advancing functional prototypes toward product-level games and evaluating continued adaptation to individual players.
paragraphs.zh: Recursive Game Creator 是一款以体验为导向的递归框架，它将设计、工具辅助实现、可执行玩法以及基于偏好的评审连接在一起。 其原生编码的 Player 通过程序化接口收集可重用的游戏玩法轨迹，而 Reviewer 则结合行为证据、视觉观察和用户输入来指导版本选择和后续修订。 这种从策略到轨迹再到反馈的循环机制，使得在固定模型参数下游戏能够持续演化。 在我们的评估中，Recursive Game Creator 在 GameCraft-Bench 上实现了当前最先进的整体性能，并在 GameASG-Bench 上达到了所比较方法中最高的平均运行时检查通过率。 开发示例和专家评估表明，该框架在控制、内容和呈现方面均有改进。 该框架为将功能性原型发展为产品级游戏，并评估其能否持续适应不同玩家提供了基础。
